events.text: A man with gray hair and beard wearing a blue plaid shirt and dark clothes is lying down on a wooden surface with a gray cushion under his head.
There are three lit candles placed among bottles behind the man, positioned near a railing with vertical balusters.
Behind the lying man, a man with short black hair and dark clothing is holding and aiming a rifle with a scope through the railing.
The man lying down initially has his eyes closed and hands resting on his abdomen.
The man lying down slowly sits up and leans against a large wooden post near the railing.
The man sitting up presses one hand to his neck and shoulder, showing discomfort or pain.
The posture of the man sitting changes to kneeling on the wooden platform while nursing his shoulder.
The sitting man holds onto a thick rope hanging near the wooden post.
The man holding the rifle is seen drinking from a yellow-orange carton labeled 'MANGO MADNESS COOL! FUN!' through a white bendy straw.
The rifle held by the younger man has a bipod resting on the wooden surface and an optical sight on top.
The setting appears to be an outdoor wooden platform, possibly a boat or ship, with ropes, wooden pillars, and nautical equipment visible.
The man sitting up displays expressions of pain and exhaustion throughout the sequence.
The younger man holding the rifle maintains a vigilant, alert posture while drinking from the carton.
